title: feat(ui,spec): userActions.exportCsv false hides the console Export entry
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoM2Z7gQnCvEUfEceUuUKyBZ)_
Fixes #35619

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none — skills/** never teaches the object-level `userActions` block (its only `userActions` hits are the VIEW-level block in objectstack-ui's list-views and navigation rules); the author-facing docs are updated here (content/docs/data-modeling/objects.mdx, content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-list.mdx)

## 维护者速读

- 搭建者在对象表单里关掉「导出」开关后,该对象的表格、列表页和报表都不再显示「导出」按钮;以前关了也照样显示,没设置的对象不变。
- 替在设计器里关掉导出开关的搭建者兑现这个设置:开关一直能设,却从没生效(维护者已裁定「生效」而不是「删除」)。
- 出错最多是某个对象的导出按钮该显示却不显示,或反之;它只隐藏入口、不拦服务端导出,整改动可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

Ruling: **Enforce** (comment 7035537883 on the card). An object's `userActions.exportCsv: false` now hides the console's Export entry for that object's records, in every format. Every surface reads one verdict, `resolveEffectiveCrudAffordances(objectSchema, effectiveApiOperations).exportCsv` from `@object-ui/core`. That verdict is the authored bit over the object's `managedBy` default, ANDed with the caller's effective `export` operation. Before this change the surfaces read only the effective operation, so `exportCsv: false` changed nothing.

- **ObjectGrid** (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`): one name, `objectExportOffered`, gates three things: the toolbar Export menu (`exportEnabled`), `handleExport`, and the table's own CSV button that `operations.export: true` turns on (`exportable`).
- **ListView** (`@object-ui/plugin-list`): `exportPermitted` folds in the verdict. Both toolbar forms already read that name: the wide toolbar's Export button and the Display panel's export footer. `handleExport` reads it too.
- **Dataset report** (`@object-ui/plugin-report`): `ReportExportControl` reads the base object's definition (the query answer's `object`) through the report's data source with `useSettledSchema`, then applies the same verdict. `DatasetReportRenderer` passes its `dataSource` down.
- **RelatedList**: no change. It draws no export entry at all, so there is nothing to gate. Evidence is in Acceptance notes.
- **Spec** (`@objectstack/spec`):
  - the `exportCsv` describe and the Studio object form's help text now say what the key does;
  - the liveness ledger row `object.userActions.exportCsv` moves `dead` → `live`, citing the readers by `file#symbol`;
  - the generated reference row and the state-count shard are regenerated.
- **Docs**: the `userActions` row in content/docs/data-modeling/objects.mdx; a new "The object's Export switch" section in content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-list.mdx; an Export section in each of the three plugin READMEs.
- **Translations** (`@objectstack/platform-objects`): the English metadata-forms bundle is regenerated for the new help text. The ten translated locales keep their wording (merge mode).
- Changeset: `.changeset/35619-user-actions-export-csv-enforced.md`. It grades spec and the three ui plugins `minor` and platform-objects `patch`, and carries the `Clause-②:` and `Metadata-protocol:` lines.

Unchanged, per the rulings: the ADR-0103 bucket defaults (`exportCsv: true` in every bucket) and ADR-0153. No server gate is added; the REST export route is out of scope. The setting hides an entry and is not a permission: who may export is still the permission set's `allowExport`.

### Read first (by risk)

1. `ui/packages/plugin-report/src/ReportExport.tsx`: the new definition read through the data source. A source that cannot serve `getObjectSchema` keeps the control, and so does a definition still in flight (fail-open).
2. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`: the `exportable: operations?.export && objectExportOffered` hunk. The table's own CSV button now also follows the effective `export` operation, which it did not read before.
3. `packages/spec/liveness/object.json`: the `exportCsv` row's flip and its evidence anchors.

### Two-minute check

`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/exportCsvGate-35619.test.tsx`. Expect `Tests  4 passed (4)`: `exportCsv: false` finds neither the toolbar Export menu nor the table's CSV button, and the three controls find both.

## Tests

New render-level pins. Each `false` case has CONTROLS that find the entry, so an absence is a reading and not a blind probe.

- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/exportCsvGate-35619.test.tsx` (4):
  - `exportCsv: false` hides both the toolbar Export menu and the table CSV button;
  - CONTROL: unset keeps both;
  - CONTROL: `true` keeps both;
  - closing `edit`/`delete` leaves export open.
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.harness.test.tsx`, new top-level `describe('ListView.exportCsvGate-35619')` (5):
  - wide toolbar: `false` hides Export; CONTROLS for unset and `true`;
  - Display panel footer: `false` hides every format entry; CONTROL.
- `ui/packages/plugin-report/src/__tests__/ReportExport.exportCsvGate-35619.test.tsx` (3): `false` hides the report's Export control; CONTROLS for unset and `true`.

Readings. Code head is 3e175d09; 44437834 adds only the regenerated English bundle in `@objectstack/platform-objects` and the changeset.

## Acceptance notes

- **RelatedList has no export entry.** The ruling names RelatedList as an export surface. At `origin/main`, `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` draws no Export button, menu or handler, and sets `exportable: false` on its table, so there is nothing to gate. The diff does not touch it, and the ledger note records this.
- **Fail-open while the definition loads.** All three surfaces resolve with the bucket default until the object definition lands. Sibling affordances behave the same way. Every bucket defaults `exportCsv` to `true`, so the entry can show for a moment on an object that authors `false`. The pins wait for the definition before they look.
- **Table CSV button now follows the effective `export` operation.** Before, the data-table's own CSV button (`operations.export: true`) read nothing but that flag. It now reads `objectExportOffered`, which includes the server's effective operation set. This matches the toolbar menu it sits beside.
- **Legacy `ReportViewer` untouched.** It gates on the report's own `allowExport` and is not bound to an object.
- **Interim changeset text.** The unreleased `.changeset/35401-user-actions-transfer.md` paragraph says `exportCsv` is dead and warns. If both changesets ship in one release, that paragraph describes an interim state, and the seat may amend it as a DELIBERATE CORRECTION. This PR does not edit another PR's changeset.
- **Translated help text kept.** The ten translated `userActions.exportCsv` help texts still say "the CSV export entry, shown when unset". That is still true, but they do not yet mention every format or that the setting is not a permission. Merge mode keeps them, and they are legacy-trusted, so no gate reads them as stale. Refreshing them is translation work and is not done here.
- **Pin placement.** The claim asked for new pin files named for 35619 beside each surface. The ListView pin sits in the shared `ListView.harness.test.tsx` as a top-level describe instead, per the AGENTS.md shared-harness ruling (6583487846).
- **Overlap.** `overlap-check` at 44437834 reports a textual conflict with #35923, only on two generated artifacts: `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx` and `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/object.md`. Both PRs regenerate them, so whichever lands second merges main and regenerates them. Every other shared file merges cleanly.

## Verification

Local subset: the families `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives at 44437834 (122 commands). Exit codes were captured before any pipe.


- 117 families ran at 3e175d09 and exited 0.
- Three refused their prerequisite there (exit 3). Each passed after its prerequisite was met:
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`, once its pinned fixture commit was fetched;
  - `check:skill-examples`, once client-react was built;
  - `check:i18n`, once the CLI closure was built.
- `check:i18n` then went red (exit 1, `platform-objects DRIFTED (1)`). That red came from this diff: the object form's `exportCsv` help text is extracted into `en.metadata-forms.generated.ts`. 44437834 regenerates it with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` (only `en` moved), and `pnpm check:i18n` now exits 0 with every bundle in sync.
- At 44437834 these exited 0: `check:i18n-stale-fill` (new to the derivation), the two changeset checks, `check:nul-bytes` and `check:published-files`.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs every package built (36 have no `dist/`), so it is NOT MEASURED locally: declared narrowing, and CI runs it.
- `check:dev-prereqs` is local-only: exit 1, "the workspace is not built", 23 of 108 packages have no `dist/`. That describes this container, not the diff.
- `check:liveness` exited 0 and `check:generated --fix` regenerated the two artifacts this PR commits.
</details>
